name: @olai/plugin-kolu
//exports: Five entries, and the first three are DISJOINT graphs — it is `@olai/kolu-client`'s own split one floor down, grown a door. `./wire` is the member declarations and nothing else, reached through `@olai/plugins/wire`: everything that composes or reads the surface pulls it in statically, so it may carry no UI runtime (a server reads it) and no padi (a browser will). The root is the MANIFEST — the dressing, the chrome and the tab's own mount — and that is where this plugin's browser faces hang, which is `@olai/kolu-ui` and therefore SolidJS and an emulator. `./server` is the RUNTIME HALF: the `koluHalf` call, the two vault walks, and the deps a composition root hands `implementSurfaces`. It is its own door for one reason and it is the whole reason — a server reaching the runtime half through the manifest would pull a UI runtime onto the graph of a process that renders nothing, which is the hazard `@olai/kolu-client/wire`'s own fence was written for one floor down. The last two are the browser half's two contracts with packages that never import it: `./testids` is NAMES ONLY, so a scenario asserts on this package's own DOM without pulling a component into a suite that has no browser, and `./all.css` is the sheet — the appliance's chain plus a `@source` at these faces, because Tailwind emits only what it can SEE and a moved component nothing points at renders with no layout and nothing errors. `@olai/plugins` mirrors the three code doors and `packages/plugins/src/fence.test.ts` walks each closure.
//: THE KOLU TENANT — everything that says `kolu`, on this side of the wall. It WRAPS rather than replaces: `@olai/kolu-client` is still the dial and the wire, `@olai/kolu-ui` is still every kolu-rendered face, and what lives here is olai's own judgement ABOUT kolu — what an absent padi MEANS, which vault file is kolu's, which property kind wears the terminal door, and the chrome pill that says whether this olai can see the terminals at all — which used to be spread across `@olai/chat`, `@olai/server` and `@olai/web` under kolu-shaped filenames in general packages.
//dependencies: The two kolu packages, the vault's own vocabulary, and SolidJS. `@olai/format` is here because the two vault walks are — `claimants.ts` and `config.ts` read outline records, which is precisely why they may not live in `@olai/kolu-client` (whose interfaces are parametric in the node type so a compiler holds it to that) and why they no longer live in `@olai/server` (a general package with an appliance in a filename). It is a devDependency nowhere: the walks are product. `solid-js` is a runtime dependency because this package now owns two components — the padi pill and the tab's mount — which are olai's chrome about kolu rather than kolu's own rendering, and therefore belong on neither side of the wall this package sits on. `@olai/plugins` is deliberately ABSENT and its absence is structural rather than tidy: that package imports THIS one, so a dependency back would be a cycle the manifests could not express. The manifest is a plain `as const` and the registry's `satisfies` is what proves it fits — the same structural agreement `@olai/ops` keeps with the surface's `Status`, and the same one `@olai/kolu-ui` already keeps with the drawer's entry. `@olai/web` is absent for the same reason a hop further out: the pill needs the bar's geometry, the app's popover and its door onto a served file, and every one of those arrives as a VALUE (src/browser/app.ts declares the shapes structurally and argues why) rather than as an import that would be a cycle. `@olai/surface` is absent for the same reason one more hop.
